summary: Defines a Sieve extension for comparing the parts of an address that uses subaddressing, such as ken+sieve@example.org, namely the user and detail parts. It is a proposed standard and was replaced by RFC 5233.

eli5.summary: Some mail systems let you add a tag after a plus sign in your address. This memo lets mail filter rules look at the name and the tag separately.

questions: filter email by plus address detail
